answer: A slashable stake bond tied to earned reputation resists sybils. A new agent must lock collateral before attesting work, and each verified job adds to its standing, like layers forming marble: cheap to start, costly to fake at scale. A sybil operator spinning up thousands of identities must fund every bond and wait through the same slow climb, while one proven misdeed burns the stake and resets the score. Auditors spot-check attestations, and a crystal-clear public ledger exposes every stake and slash, so a spiral of fake identities collapses once its cost exceeds any reward.
